reason: Historical test incorrectly asserted that round_22 must never exist, preventing legitimate later-round progression.
original_semantic_intent: Round-22 did not exist when Round-21 was completed.
amended_semantic_intent: Round-22 must not have existed before Round-21 lock; later legal Round creation is permitted.
scope: Only the one Round-21 lifecycle assertion was changed. The original lock remains byte-for-byte immutable; this amendment is a strict single-path hash overlay.

round23_successor_lifecycle_clarificatio.reason: The existing legal-successor semantic assertion named Round-22 literally, although its stated intent permits later legal rounds. Round-23 is an authorized successor of the locked Round-22 state.

round24_successor_lifecycle_clarificatio.reason: The same legal-successor assertion had to admit explicitly authorized Round-24 after the locked Round-23 state; the historical lock-time fact remains unchanged.

round25_successor_lifecycle_clarificatio.reason: The authorized Round-25 diagnostic successor must be accepted by the existing legal-successor lifecycle assertion. The locked-time fact that Round-22 was absent at the Round-21 lock remains unchanged.

round26_successor_lifecycle_clarificatio.reason: The existing legal-successor lifecycle assertion must admit the explicitly authorized Round-26 diagnostic successor without changing the original Round-21 lock-time fact.
